task.title: Atomically anonymize expired consultations under an isolated authorized policy
task.input: M4-T7 retention policy/fixed job, M4-T11 actual activity writes, and section 09 transactional rechecks.
task.output: Anonymization branches in retention-service/repo, policy version, and protection against competing new activity; dry-run remains the default and no production cleanup is executed.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: existing chat-retention -> currently authorized policy branch -> transaction rereading lastActivityAt/retainUntil/policyVersion. Execute only on isolated authorized data. New successful exchange after scanning causes an old candidate to be skipped. An unchanged expired target has body/email/sensitive context anonymized and further replies disabled (E-87). 2) Reuse M4-T9 hidden-poll/offline and M4-T4 notification-retry prerequisites, adding only retainUntil assertions: repeated refresh GET, hidden-tab polling, read, and SMTP notification retries/receipts leave the 90-day deadline unchanged; only successfully saved visitor messages or human replies advance it. Cookie expiry does not cascade-delete content. Foreign keys use Restrict and empty sessions are reclaimed only after every consultation is anonymized. Without explicit authorization, real writes still reject with deletedCount zero. Existing inquiry/analytics/recovered/backup data is unchanged (E-86, E-88, E-89).
